ev.q: A total of 12 cases, all laboratory confirmed, have been reported from residents of New York (five)
Eleven of the 12 patients were interviewed. All were women; median age was 32 years
reported from residents of New York (five), Massachusetts (two), North Carolina (two)
Symptoms of infection began a median of 5 weeks after surgery (range: 1--20 weeks)
